verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Svelte's reactive state primitives ($state, $derived, $effect, plus reassignable derived values for optimistic UI). It also shows SvelteKit as a full-stack framework with clear server and client loading, which loosely supports treating loaded data as reactive state. Nothing in the pack documents resource- or suspense-style primitives for pending or loading UI. Missing for 10: documented async resource/suspense primitives, loading or pending-state UI patterns, an explicit link between server load data and reactive state, hands-on corroboration.
